state_authority: Existing CORE_DB Mongo application custody; pure snapshots have no independent storage authority

public_api.checkpoint: Synchronous on_checkpoint(snapshot,event), including dispatch_reserved BEFORE IO and outcome AFTER IO. Rejected final checkpoint restores last committed reservation; no uncharged network retry. Callback must resolve ambiguous storage outcomes before releasing physical worker.
public_api.scope: Exact tenant_id/owner_id immutable binding; application authenticates, authorizes and fences unexpired lease/version/source authority
public_api.evidence: CrawlRun.search(query,limit<=8): exact offset-anchored preserved-text passages, lexical ranking and untrusted-instruction review signals; no provider call or factual verification

semantics.robots: Fail closed on unavailable robots; revalidation, TTL and every redirect target; delays checkpointed
semantics.dedupe: Canonical URL and full normalized content SHA256; same-content URL aliases retained
semantics.provenance: Actual requested/final URL, status, timestamps, raw body SHA256, full normalized text SHA256, preserved text SHA256/truncation and consent binding; no raw response bytes retained
semantics.learning: Bounded lexical evidence observations and exact-span retrieval under existing mission-quality functions, explicitly unreviewed external content. No verified knowledge, calibration, XP, model updates or training rights.
semantics.durability: Request slot and maximum possible response bytes are checkpointed BEFORE network as pending_dispatch; outcome atomically settles known bytes and content. Uncertain outcome retains reservation across recovery; committed source IDs dedupe. Full frontier, robots, retry timers and source text in same application snapshot.
semantics.recovery: Backend fences old worker before restore. Pending dispatch becomes unknown outcome with full cap retained and bounded retry; external IO is at-least-once, not exactly-once.
semantics.control: Explicit pause/resume/cancel; no OS idle/activity inference; consent must remain current before network and commit
semantics.accounting: usage.bytes is measured accepted transport-body bytes; usage.reserved_bytes is conservative allowance for in-flight or unknown failed response bytes. Both consume total byte budget. Request count is reserved dispatch attempts, not independently attested remote server requests.
semantics.autonomous_application: Application may consume explicit finite CORE_DB grants through the existing backend scheduler. Pure run_slice remains at most4steps/45seconds; no independent pure background loop, storage, scheduler or authority. Canonical code binding and pre-IO reservation remain unchanged.

network.direct: Validated public DNS addresses pinned to socket with original TLS SNI/hostname verification
network.configured_proxy: Inherited explicit HTTP(S)_PROXY settings with HTTP proxy endpoints; preserve original origin hostname in absolute URI/CONNECT and TLS SNI, public-origin DNS admission. Proxy resolves origin connection; do not claim origin-peer pinning. HTTPS proxy endpoints unsupported fail-closed. No proxy endpoint/credentials exported.
network.credentials: No caller headers, cookies, authorization, source URL userinfo or custom origin ports; no provider SDK/model call

resolver.implementation: bounded isolated stdlib Python DNS helper; minimal noncredential environment; maximum eight helpers; bounded response; deadline termination and wait; retain capacity for any unconfirmed process until reaped
resolver.authority: No new service/store/scheduler/runtime owner; configured proxy hostname may resolve privately as deployment trusted endpoint, origin DNS must resolve exclusively publicly

verification: No tests per user instruction. Static checks plus actual authorized bounded public URL acquisition only. Candidate does not change closure/signoff.
